convivialists.m: More than one convivialist. convivialist: a person of convivial habits.

convocational.m: Of or pertaining to a convocation.

convoker.m: One who convokes or calls together.

convokers.m: More than one convoker. convoker: one who convokes or calls together.

convolutional.m: Of, pertaining to, or causing convolution.

convolvulaceous.m: Of, pertaining to, or resembling the family of plants Convolvulaceae, bindweeds and morning glories.

convulsants.m: More than one convulsant. convulsant: causing or producing convulsions.
